strings.모험가님께서 제 부탁을 들어주신다니 감사드려요. 사실 제가 아니고 도움이: Thank you for agreeing to help, adventurer. Actually, someone else needs help, rather than me.
I heard you visited the Amaloon Desert recently.
Yes, I had some business there...
strings.모험가님 덕분에 정화된 바람의 정령들이 잠시 사막에 머물렀었는데, 다른: The wind spirits you purified stayed in the desert for a while. It seems they were near the princess from another world.
strings.그분께서 깊은 고민이 있으신지, 바람의 정령들이 돌아왔을 때, 많은 걱정: She must have something weighing on her. When the spirits returned, I sensed a great deal of worry.
Tia went through something terrible. Her younger sibling...
You needn't tell me everything. It couldn't be helped.
I wish I could help her, but there's nothing I can do...
If you have time, please listen to the princess. I ask this as the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability.
strings.네, 그럴게요. 티야에게 일이 생기면 제가 돕기로 약속했거든요. 그럼 나: I will. I promised Tia I'd help if anything happened. See you later, Harmonia.
Hello, adventurer. It's good to see you again.
strings.안색이 안 좋아보여요. 혹시 무슨 일이라도 생겼나요?: You look unwell. Has something happened?
strings.별 건 아니고, 고향 생각이 나서요. 돌아갈 수 있는 방법을 찾아보고 있: Nothing in particular. I was thinking of home. I've been looking for a way back, but it's all so uncertain.
I'm sorry. I need to help Iris find a way soon...
strings.괜찮아요. 너무 무리하진 마세요. 다 방법이 있을테니까요. 마음 써주셔서: It's all right. Don't push yourself too hard. There must be a way. Thank you for caring.
strings.모험가님 말고도 도움을 주시겠다고 한 분이 계세요. 혹시 케이스라는 분을: Someone else offered to help, too. Do you know a person named Keise?
Keise? The archaeologist at Treasure Beach.
strings.네, 고고학자라고 하시더군요. 프레이오스 대륙에서 고고학을 비롯해 여러: Yes, an archaeologist. She said she's researched archaeology and many other subjects across Freios.
strings.그런데 어떻게 여기까지 왔대요?: How did she come all the way here?
strings.저도 자세한 건 모르지만, 이스트랜드의 연구를 위해 얼마 전에 루맨에 오: I don't know the details, but she recently came to Lumen to research Eastland.
strings.여기저기 돌아다니다 이곳까지 오셨고, 저를 만나 이런 저런 이야기를 나누: Her travels brought her here, and we spoke about many things. After hearing my situation, she offered to help.
strings.저희 세계에서 온 유물로 연구하고 조사를 시작해야 하는데, 저와 케이스: Keise needs relics from our world to begin the research, but neither of us is strong enough to get them.
strings.안식의 홀에 자료가 될만한 유물이 있는 공간이 있어요. 그곳의 유물이라면: There's an area in the Hall of Rest with relics that could serve as material. They should help Keise's research.
strings.아, 거기라면 제가 알아요. 너무 걱정마세요. 그런데 케이스는 어디있죠?: Oh, I know the place. Don't worry. Where is Keise now?
She said grave robbers were increasing at Treasure Beach and hurried back.
strings.그럼 어쩔 수 없죠. 제가 물건을 구해서 바로 가져다 줄게요. 너무 걱정: Then I'll get the relics and take them straight to her. Don't worry.
strings.뭔가 더 하고 싶은 말이 있는거 아니에요?: Isn't there something else you wanted to say?
I was going to say something, but I've forgotten. I'll tell you when I remember.
You look tired. Leave this to me and rest a little. I'll be back.
strings.고마워요, 모험가님. 아, 벌써 가셨네. 언제나 일을 빨리 처리하시려고: Thank you, adventurer. Oh, already gone. Always so eager to get things done...
strings.(티야가 모험가를 배웅하고 돌아가려는 앞에 안경을 낀 여성이 서 있다.): (After seeing the adventurer off, Tia turns to find a woman in glasses standing before her.)
strings.누구시죠? 언제부터 계셨던 거죠?: Who are you? How long have you been there?
strings.놀라게 해드렸다면 죄송합니다. 빛의 연합 맹주인 지스카드 님의 제자 유란: I'm sorry if I startled you. I'm Yuran, disciple of Ziskad, leader of the Alliance of Light.
Oh, adventurer! It's been a while. Thank you again for last time.
Of course. The reason I'm here...
strings.헛, 그 물건은 피라미드 유물! 역시 모험가님이군요. 그곳에 들어갔던 사: Oh! That's a pyramid relic! Just what I'd expect of you. Very few people have entered that place... Amazing!
You can have it. Please tell me when your research is complete.
strings.제가 이스트랜드 역사를 비롯해서 아말룬 사막과 다른 세계인 '라'까지 조: Researching Eastland's history, the Amaloon Desert, and the other world, 'Ra,' will take a long time. And...
The longer the explanation, the more I suspect you're short on material.
strings.빙고! 역시 금방 아시는군요. 하나면 될 줄 알았는데, 이걸로는 정보가: Bingo! Quick as ever. I thought one would suffice, but it doesn't provide enough information.
Exactly four. No more, no less. I'm truly sorry.
I'll go. Tell me if you learn anything while I'm away.
Don't worry. Keise always keeps a promise. Hehe.
strings.그 무거운 물건을 잘도 들고 오셨군요. 거기서 여기까지 보통 거리도 아닐: You carried those heavy things all this way? That's no short journey. Impressive.
strings.꽤 무거웠어요. 이 정도면 되겠죠?: They were quite heavy. Is this enough?
strings.물론이에요. 좀 어렵긴 하지만, 제 지식과 경험을 모두 쏟아부을게요. 안: Of course. It'll be difficult, but I'll put all my knowledge and experience into it. The Alliance of Light has offered support, too.
strings.빛의 연합 맹주인 지스카드 님의 제자요. 이름이 뭐더라. 안경을 쓰고 단: A disciple of Ziskad, its leader. What was her name? The one with glasses, decisive gestures, and a stern expression.
strings.안 그래도 아말룬 사막의 일을 저보고 다 해결하라고 했던 사람인데…. 이: She's the one who told me to handle everything in the Amaloon Desert... I'm surprised she offered help so readily.
strings.그래도 상당히 친절하셨던 분이었어요. 하여튼 제 연구와 조사가 이뤄지는: She was quite kind. Anyway, I'll report my findings to the Alliance of Light.
strings.그나저나 이 연구가 제 커리어를 넓혀줄 거란 생각이 들어서 공주님한테 미: Still, I feel bad for the princess. I keep thinking how this research will advance my career. Am I just satisfying my own ambitions...?
strings.모험가님, 혹시 제 부탁을 들어주실 수 있나요?: Adventurer, could I ask you a favor?
strings.공주님에게 선물을 주고 싶은데…. 아무래도 그 선물이 멀리 있어서 말이죠: I'd like to give the princess a gift... But it's rather far away.
strings.공주님이 사막 출신이라 한 번도 바다를 본 적이 없대요. 그래서 바다를: She grew up in the desert and has never seen the sea. I thought something that holds the sea within it would be nice.
strings.아마도 좋은 선물이 되겠죠? 공주님이 가진 마력에 반응하면 빛나서 더 아: A good gift, don't you think? It'll shine in response to her magic and become even more beautiful.
Though the princess's beauty would outshine even that.
strings.아, 티야 공주님. 너무 예쁘지 않나요?: Ah, Princess Tia. Isn't she lovely?
strings.미인이긴 하시죠. 하여튼, 트윙키브를 한 번 돌아야겠군요. 그러면 물건: She is beautiful. Anyway, I'll need to make a trip through Twinkive. I'll get it and take it straight to her.
Yes, yes. Take care on your way. This beach is still dangerous.
Yes. It went more smoothly than expected.
Oh, Keise asked me to bring you a gift.
strings.바다의 기운이 잔뜩 담겨 있는 물건인데, 티야가 가지고 있는 마력과 반응: It's full of the sea's energy. She said it would respond to your magic and give you a sense of the ocean.
strings.와…. 너무 예뻐요. 좋은 사람도 알게 해주시고, 이런 진귀한 물건도 받: Oh... It's beautiful. You've introduced me to kind people, and now brought such a rare gift.
strings.아, 문득 돌아가신 아버지가 생각나서요. 아버지께서도 바다를 보지 못하셨: Oh, I suddenly thought of my late father. He never saw the sea, either. Nor did my younger sibling...
Keise also suggested going to see the sea together.
I can't wait. The sea... Thank you so much.
Thank Keise, rather than me. I'm all right.
I'm so fortunate to have met so many good people.
That's because you're a good person yourself, Tia.
Thank you, adventurer. I'll do my best.
strings.저번에도 말씀드린 것처럼 라의 왕족으로 할 수 있는 책임을 끝까지 다할게: As I said before, I'll fulfill my responsibilities as a member of Ra's royal family to the very end.
Oh, someone named Yuran came from Lumen while you were away.
She came to assess the situation herself and make plans for what comes next. She left quickly, though...
strings.안 그래도 모험가님에 대한 말씀을 하셨어요. 모험가님에게 드릴게 있다면서: She mentioned you. She said she had something for you and asked me to tell you to visit Lumen when I saw you.
Go see her. It might be something good.
Shall I? Then I'll be going, Tia.
strings.언제든지 놀러오세요. 기다릴게요!: Visit whenever you like. I'll be waiting!
I went to see Tia in the Amaloon Desert and heard you'd visited. She said you wanted me to come to Lumen...
Nothing major. I called you because I have something to give you.
strings.아말룬 사막의 일을 해결해주셔서, 저희가 데이모스 암흑 성국을 상대하는데: Resolving the trouble in the Amaloon Desert has strengthened our position against the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos.
strings.자세한 건 말씀드리기 힘들지만, 스승님의 뜻에 따라 앞으로 무슨 일을 하: I can't go into detail, but at my master's request, we wish to grant you a title that will help in your future endeavors.
strings.아, 조만간 스승님과의 자리를 마련하겠습니다. 아마도 중요한 이야기일테죠: Also, I'll arrange a meeting with my master soon. The conversation will likely be important.
strings.그럼 받아들이신 걸로 스승님께 전하겠습니다. 이리스 님께도 따로 전달할테: I'll tell him you've accepted. I'll inform Lady Iris separately, so please don't worry.
strings.육포입니다. 말씀 안 드려도 아시겠죠?: Jerky. I trust no explanation is needed?
strings.루맨의 특산물이 되는 건 좋습니다만, 소비하는 인물이 한 명뿐이라는 게: It's good that it's becoming a Lumen specialty. The fact that there's only one consumer is a little concerning.
Ahahaha. I'll sort it out somehow. Don't worry.
strings.걱정하는 건 아닙니다. 하여튼 나중에 연락 드리겠습니다. 앞으로도 잘 부: I'm not worried. In any case, I'll contact you later. We look forward to working with you.
strings.네, 알겠습니다. 그럼 수고하세요. 하아, 내 돈…. 육포를 뭐 이리 많: Understood. Take care. Sigh... My money... How did so much jerky get eaten...?
